title: CsChat
description: CsChat gives you the Control over your Chat. It has many features such as a Private Messaging System, Chat Colours, Items Preview, and much more.
body:
**SOCIALS:**
  
- Discord → discord.gg/6DMUpwqc8k
- Youtube → youtube.com/[USER=806911]Cham-Studios[/USER]
- Github → github.com/Cham-Studios
- X → x.com/StudiosCham
- Contact → chamstudios@proton.me
- Modrinth → https://modrinth.com/user/Cham-Studios
  
  
  
 **FEATURES:**

- -> Control over your Chat
- -> Customize your Chat Format
- -> Chat Colours
- -> Clear, Enable or Disable your Chat
- -> Staff & Admin Chat included
- -> Custom Permissions
- -> Private Messaging System
- -> Send a Preview of your Items in Chat
- -> Broadcast Messages
- -> Anti Spam, Swearing, Slurs, etc..
- -> Enable or Disable Featurs of your choice
- -> Custom Death Messages
- -> Emojis
- -> Auto Responses to specific Words
- -> Hover Stats over a Player
- -> Mentioning System
- -> All Messages are Logged in a Text Document
- -> Chat Cooldown
- -> Join & Leave Messages
- -> Automatic Broadcasts
  
  
  
 **COMMANDS:**

- -> /cschat help
- -> /cschat reload
- -> /cschat enable/disable
- -> /cschat clear
- -> /cschat colour <colour-name>
- -> /msg <player> <message>
- -> /staffchat
- -> /adminchat
- -> /broadcast
  
  
  
 **PERMISSION:**

- -> cschat.admin
- -> cschat.staffchat
- -> cschat.adminchat
- -> cschat.bypass.cooldown
- -> cschat.broadcast
- -> cschat.bypass.words
